result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, a popular card cut off by the bottom navigation, and inconsistent favorite icon styling.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' row shows restaurant name truncated mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' at the right screen edge without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal scroll padding and use ellipsis or wrapping for card titles so names are not cut mid-character

issues.description: Second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off mid-image by the bottom tab bar with no restaurant name, rating or metadata visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure scrollable content has bottom padding above the tab bar so cards are fully readable and do not appear broken or overlapped

issues.description: Favorite heart overlay icons in 'Popular right now' are inconsistent - one has no background and one has a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Standardize overlay button style with a consistent scrim/background for contrast and touch target visibility
